info.title: Xibo API
info.description:
Xibo CMS API.
       Using HTTP formData requests.
       All PUT requests require Content-Type:application/x-www-form-urlencoded header.

campaignId.description: The Campaign ID to use for this Event. If a Layout is needed then the Campaign specific ID for that Layout should be used.

fullScreenCampaignId.description: For Media or Playlist event Type. The Layout specific Campaign ID to use for this Event. This needs to be the Layout created with layout/fullscreen function

commandId.description: The Command ID to use for this Event.

mediaId.description: The Media ID to use for this Event.

displayOrder.description: The display order for this event.

isPriority.description: An integer indicating the priority of this event. Normal events have a priority of 0.

displayGroupIds.description: The Display Group IDs for this event. Display specific Group IDs should be used to schedule on single displays.

dayPartId.description: The Day Part for this event. Overrides supported are 0(custom) and 1(always). Defaulted to 0.

syncTimezone.description: Should this schedule be synced to the resulting Display timezone?

fromDt.description: The from date for this event.

toDt.description: The to date for this event.

recurrenceType.description: The type of recurrence to apply to this event.

recurrenceRange.description: The end date for this events recurrence.

recurrenceRepeatsOn.description: The days of the week that this event repeats - weekly only

scheduleReminders.description: Array of Reminders for this event

isGeoAware.description: Flag (0-1), whether this event is using Geo Location

geoLocation.description: Array of comma separated strings each with comma separated pair of coordinates

geoLocationJson.description: Valid GeoJSON string, use as an alternative to geoLocation parameter

actionType.description: For Action eventTypeId, the type of the action - command or navLayout

actionTriggerCode.description: For Action eventTypeId, the webhook trigger code for the Action

actionLayoutCode.description: For Action eventTypeId and navLayout actionType, the Layout Code identifier

dataSetId.description: For Data Connector eventTypeId, the DataSet ID

dataSetParams.description: For Data Connector eventTypeId, the DataSet params
